text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! My heart is pounding!
There are so many strong opponents waiting for us!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is bringing the secret techniques
they've honed for this very day...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Dreaming of the moment I can unleash my burst and leave my rivals in the dust, I stand here...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, I can't get enough of this!
To think we're guaranteed such a hot-blooded battle sequence!
choice_data_list: Looks like this is going to be an interesting race.
Looks like this is going to be a fun race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's definitely going to be interesting! With all eyes glued to the crowd—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They're moving up.
The long-awaited protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm going out to fight!
To shine right here!
